subject.label: Subject
subject.why: Every colleague card ER starts '[Card] ' and is short English (p75 length 39, n=20); the user's own subjects (e.g. 51-char '[Card] ARL FedEx Shipping Fee for Sequencing Samples') and the scripts' ' - date (KRW amount)' suffix run longer than office practice. Wire-transfer ERs (300485, 300613) drop the prefix; this rulebook covers the card flow.

budget_type.label: Budget Type
budget_type.why: All 30 docs (own and colleague) show 'R&D'; the DOM option value is '02' (submit_2609_card_er.py).

payment.label: Payment
payment.why: Only two payment kinds appear across 30 docs; card ERs ([Card] subject) are always 'Corporate Credit Card' (see conditional).

invoice[].label: Date of Invoice
invoice[].why: Card transaction date, prefilled by the system.

item_desc[].label: Cate No
item_desc[].why: All 28 card-row docs (own and colleague) show 'none'.

account_str[].label: Account Code
account_str[].why: Account is '[6-digit code] label' chosen by expense kind (see conditionals: IT 410318, shipping 410911, conference 410306, overtime meal 412103); colleagues also use 410703 Reagent & Supplies, 410901 Office supplies, 412107 Team Activities (RS-only budget).

item_name[].label: Description
item_name[].why: Colleagues write a short English item name (p75 length 21, n=16 non-empty; overtime meals list the diners, team activities leave it blank); the user's descriptions with dates or purposes appended run longer. Korean is not allowed (project rule).

item_qty[].label: Qty
item_qty[].why: Every card row in all 28 card docs is Qty 1 (one card charge = one row).

item_amount_ral1[].label: Amount excl. VAT
item_amount_ral1[].why: Derived from the card charge; for overseas IT it equals the total (memory), which this checker cannot test.

item_amount_vat[].label: VAT
item_amount_vat[].why: VAT handling is office practice by expense kind: overseas IT subscriptions VAT 0, FedEx shipping and conference registration VAT = total/11 (memory, 26 and 5 precedents); only the VAT=0 case is checkable (conditional). The user's April RunPod ERs 292446/292644 split VAT and were the reason for the rule.

item_amount[].label: Total Amount
item_amount[].why: The card charge in KRW, prefilled.

seller_korea[].label: Payee/Vendor
seller_korea[].why: Merchant name from the card company (often Korean, e.g. 페더럴익스프레스코리아 유한회사); a fact of the transaction.

seller[].label: Vendor (English, not shown on view)
seller[].why: English vendor name typed by the drafter; not visible on document_view, so no precedent.

p_reason.label: Comment (hidden; scripts mirror Notes into it)
p_reason.why: Colleagues write one short English purpose sentence or leave it empty (p75 length 67, n=11 non-empty); invoice/AWB details belong in attachments. Exception: RunPod uses the user-fixed 101-char note (conditional), which exceeds this limit.

notes.label: Notes
notes.why: The visible Notes field (DOM 'notes'; 'p_reason' is a hidden comment box). Colleagues write one short English purpose sentence or leave it empty (p75 length 67, n=11 non-empty); invoice/AWB details belong in attachments. Exception: RunPod uses the user-fixed 101-char note (conditional), which exceeds this limit.

org_name.label: Event Name (410306 only)
org_name.why: Shown when the account is 410306; name of the conference. English per project rule (own 293384 used Korean, 296590 English).

organizer_nm.label: Organizer (410306 only)
organizer_nm.why: Organizing body of the event, English.

venue[].label: Venue (meeting accounts)
venue[].why: Team Activities (412107) ERs name a short English venue (p75 length 22, n=10).

meeting_begin_date[].label: Date/Time start (meeting accounts)
meeting_begin_date[].why: Rendered 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM ~ YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM' on every Team Activities ER.

participants[].label: Participants (meeting accounts)
participants[].why: Comma-separated English names on every Team Activities ER; who attended is a fact of the case, only the language is office practice.

purpose[].label: Purpose & Minutes (meeting accounts)
purpose[].why: One or two English sentences on what the meeting was for (p75 length 103, n=10).

conditional.why: All 28 [Card] ERs are paid by corporate credit card.
